text.en: Pick 10 leaves from the rows that look worst, from the top and bottom of the trees. Lay them on a plain page, underside up.
text.sw: Chuma majani 10 kutoka mistari inayoonekana mibaya zaidi, juu na chini ya miti. Yaweke kwenye karatasi safi, upande wa chini ukiangalia juu.

answers.note: Several leaves from upper and lower canopy (Nuru field study). Rust shows on the underside (S03).
